high_level_description: This image features a person standing outdoors during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the soft pink and purple hues in the sky. They are holding a large, reflective mirror in front of their face, which reflects the sky and part of the mountainous landscape behind them. The word "ON" is prominently displayed in bold, orange letters across the center of the image, repeated multiple times.
